description: One committed move of a scheduled run to another window: the run, the window it sat in and the window the reader moved it to. The surface raises at most ONE of these per reader action and changes nothing itself — the host re-places the run in its own plan and re-renders. Until it does, the surface keeps the reader's pick, so the run visibly sits where it was dropped; a host that re-renders the run UNCHANGED (the same instance) does not undo that pick.

members.name: From
members.description: The window the run left, or null when it had no window yet.

members.name: IsChange
members.description: Whether the run actually changed window (a move onto the window it already sits in is not a change).

members.name: Run
members.description: The run that moved, as the host supplied it.

members.name: To
members.description: The window the run was moved to.

members.name: WindowId
members.description: The window id the host should store as the run's start window now.
